name: Tong Ren Tang Technologies Co. Ltd.
summary: Tong Ren Tang Technologies Co. Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and distributes Chinese medicine products in Mainland China and Hong Kong. It operates through three segments: The Company; Tong Ren Tang Chinese Medicine; and Others. The company develops, cultivates, processes, and purchases Chinese medicinal raw materials; retails and wholesales Chinese medicine products and healthcare products. It also offers ointments, healthcare products, tea drinks, food, foot care products, biological products, western medicine, and cosmetics.
